reviews.text: Excellent service! Daisy is always treated with great care and professionalism. A friendly and trustworthy team. I recommend them!

Both Dr. Catarina and Dr. Diana are very kind to the animals, and after the consultation they call to check on the animal's progress. My dog, Killua, was 2 months old when Dr. Diana received him; he will be 8 years old in October, and I wouldn't trade this clinic for anything.
From the moment you enter the reception area to welcoming the animals, Sandra is incredibly kind.
Well done, and keep up the good work. Your furry friend Killua
Thank you very much Joao M

Dr. Diana is an exceptional professional, very careful and attentive! Both she and Sandra provide excellent service with great responsibility. My kitten is very well cared for at the Circunvalação Veterinary Clinic!

I would like to thank doctor Diana and Sandra for the highly qualified consultation for my dog. The consultation was in English, very detailed and comprehensive. The doctor was attentive to us, provided recommendations, and took a blood sample painlessly for my dog. We were very satisfied with the service. Thank you!

By far the best veterinary clinic in Porto! The gentleness and love with which Dr. Diana and her assistant Sandra treat our animals and us, their owners, is something very special. I recommend them without hesitation 🩷 …

The best for treating animals. They prioritize the best, focusing on treating animals properly rather than charging exorbitant prices. Importantly, they make house calls. You should verify my testimony without hesitation.
This will always be my favorite clinic. Dr. Diana is a fairy godmother to cats. The best I've ever known. Sandra never lets anyone down. I always recommend them ♡
Excellent service and care for the animals.
